plugin.description: COV cover search (covers.musichoarders.xyz): aggregates high-quality album covers from 25+ streaming services, stores and databases in one search. Cover-only source, no lyrics.
config.country.title: Country
config.country.summary: Storefront country used for cover lookup (affects Apple Music / iTunes / Amazon availability). Defaults to US if your choice is unavailable.
config.sources.title: Sources (optional)
config.sources.summary: Comma-separated source ids to query, e.g. tidal,qobuz,bandcamp. Leave empty to use the curated default set (skips sources already covered by other installed plugins).
